Class Fluid

java.lang.Object
fluid.Fluid
public final class Fluid extends Object
Physical constants, in game units (pixels, seconds, water density = 1).

Real values can't be used as they are: if the ball were a real 2 cm drop, it would only break up around 6 m/s, i.e. about 18 000 px/s on screen. The constants are scaled so it breaks up around 400-500 px/s; the formulas that use them are the real ones.
